players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.detail: Key passes: 5 (top quarter of forwards: 2+); 1 assist, 5 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Shots: 0 (bottom quarter of forwards is 0 or less)
weaknesses.title: Getting shots off
tips: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.
Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.
Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
weaknesses.coach: Didn't get many shots off. Let's get you in better spots.

players.headline: Strong forward performance (8.0, top 25% for the position) - best at chance creation; work on getting shots off.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Now that's what I'm talking about, PhogsToffees. A 8.0 puts you in the top quarter of forwards.
coach.closer: Proud of you. Now go drink some water.

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: 7/15 passes (47%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: 15 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

players.headline: Solid midfielder performance (7.8, above average for the position) - best at on-ball involvement, goal threat; work on forcing passes, playing forward.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: BellyTb1, a 7.8 is above average for a midfielder. A good day at the office, and we can build on it.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

talk.opener: 4-1 to Abdina fc. Be a goldfish about the result, keep the lessons.

well.title: PhogsToffees
well.line: PhogsToffees led the way with an 8.0: 1 assist, 5 key passes.

well.title: Creating chances
well.line: 5 key passes. We made chances for each other - that's a team that likes each other.

well.title: On-ball involvement
well.line: BellyTb1: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

work_on.title: Passing
work_on.line: Passing at 65%, under the ~72% line where extra passes start hurting us. Simple and on the ground.
work_on.tip: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

work_on.title: Defending as a unit
work_on.line: Conceded 4. When we lose it, everybody gets compact and goal-side - shape before chase.
work_on.tip: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

work_on.title: Getting shots off
work_on.line: Only 3 shots all match. More runners in the box means more looks at goal.
work_on.tip: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
